Name: Among Us Portraits - Villagers
Author: emurphy42
Description:
"I was doing my tasks, I swear!"

This mod covers the base game NPCs who are friendable but not romanceable.

Options:
[list]
[*]Color to use for each NPC (all 18 official colors + 3 glitch colors, or "None" to leave that NPC unchanged; additional option for Krobus while posing as an ordinary human moviegoer)[/*]
[*]Whether to replace normal / beach / winter portraits (default true for all three)[/*]
[/list]
Loosely based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39706]HeadInTheCloudsModding's portrait template[/url].

Manifest.Name: Among Us Portraits - Villagers
Manifest.Description: Replace non-romanceable NPC portraits with Among Us crewmates.
Manifest.Author: John Peters (you know, the farmer?)
